summary: Canada filed a prospectus supplement for $3.5 billion 4.250% USD bonds due May 28, 2031. Terms: 99.777% of par, semi-annual interest from May 28, 2026, non-callable except for tax events. Bonds rank as direct unconditional obligations. Underwritten by various banks. Proceeds to fund general purposes. This is a routine sovereign debt issuance, not a special situation. No special-situation attributes. Filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). No structural or event-driven aspects warrant classification.
